title: The answer grows one token at a time
description: A proof scene of one decoder-only transformer pass. Accepted token representations pass through repeated pre-normalized attention and feed-forward blocks with residual adds. Final normalization and the vocabulary output projection produce logits. A neutral field shows candidate scores. Greedy argmax selects clear, then that token is appended to the prefix and the loop repeats. This simplified fixture is not a scientific approval.
